judge_ledger.cost_definition: Sum of process CPU including completed child descendants (resource RUSAGE_SELF plus RUSAGE_CHILDREN) across every recorded phase. Largest child RSS is a maximum, not an aggregate simultaneous memory measurement.
excluded_costs: Historical donor-library creation outside this run
LLM pretraining and proposal token generation outside the harness
Sealed held handling outside judge_final
Proposer CPU is reported per proposal; only gate and judge work is ledgered

protocol.held_policy: sealed tasks/visible/query plus sealed held opened identically for all arms at final via judge_final only; dev pool never loaded
protocol.library_plan: build in-run from sealed-held-accepted a/b programs via FragmentLibrary.add_entry with judge_final evidence, then freeze (version_hash) before arm c
protocol.verdict_rule: PROCEED iff best LLM arm accepts >=1 deep-family task where streaming accepts 0 AND cost/accepted <=Mx streaming on shared-solved tasks AND b>a or c>b strictly on identical tasks; else KILL

guard_refusals.evidence: timeout taxonomy counts from summary.json; lite verdicts drop the rc75 detail string, so any timeout is an upper bound on guard refusals; wall-time cross-check in results doc
